purpose: Deterministic playable reference router over live showcase capability contracts and public private-adapter declarations.
checks: no network side effects beyond same-origin GET of public control files
no credentials or private identifiers accepted or stored
semantic routes resolve from live manifest operations
ACT result still declares private adapter binding requirement
mobile layout collapses to one column
RETURN receipt is rendered for every evaluated event
COMMIT RETURN appends receipt-only records to browser localStorage and JSONL export; raw payload is not persisted
limitations: keyword/control classifier is deterministic and intentionally shallow
adapter fit is declarative, not proof of a live connection
bench does not send, schedule, publish or control hardware
rollback: delete /router-bench/ and remove its workbench route from showcase-manifest.json

current_classification.basis: Release defines a deterministic playable reference router; live/private adapter fit remains declarative rather than proven.
current_classification.provenance_note: Original release state is retained above as contemporaneous provenance; this field records the later lifecycle classification.
